prompts.Reinforcement Suit (Midnight Black/Cyan: Replace the character's clothes to: A high-density, segmented exoskeleton forming a sleek, brutally angular silhouette. The primary material is matte midnight black composite plating, accented with sharp cyan piping tracing every major joint and chassis line. The armor features heavy pauldrons, articulated greaves that taper sharply towards the boots, and a chest plate reinforced by overlapping, razor-edged ventral plates, giving it a distinctly aggressive mecha aesthetic.
prompts.Armorer Suit (Midnight Black): Replace the character's clothes to: A sleek, heavily articulated full-body battlesuit rendered in matte midnight black plating with high-gloss obsidian accents along the major joint seams.
